reports.limits: Remote PR scope includes open and closed/merged titles and bodies, with separate coverage and timestamps. State changes are deduplicated by latest PR update; snapshots are not atomic. Local coverage compares searched working-tree notes with regular note paths at coverage.local.head; it does not certify HEAD contents or historical coverage. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
